level7_global.comparison_arm_note: NODE_RANDOM_SEQUENTIAL comparison arm not executed (optional per request).

ambiguities.EXACT_PROTOCOL_TEXT: PHASE 1 — nodes in ascending id; at each node, one draw per E unit (convert if < a), then one draw per M unit (convert if < b), both counted on pre-step values.
ambiguities.WHY_UNDERSPECIFIED: "pre-step values" could mean the values at the start of the macro-step, or the values at the moment the node is processed (before its own E-to-M conversions are applied to M).
POSSIBLE_INTERPRETATIONS: E draws use E_i as of macro-step start; M draws use M_i as of macro-step start (before this node's E-to-M conversions).
M draws use M_i after this node's E-to-M conversions have been applied.
ambiguities.AFFECTED_CELLS_OR_METRICS: all cells; phi_emp, phi_snapshot, all seed metrics
ambiguities.DECLARED_CHOICE: Interpretation 1: conversions within a node's own processing do not affect the denominators of that node's draws this step (literal "pre-step").

ambiguities.EXACT_PROTOCOL_TEXT: Destination rule: uniform over out-neighbours of the source node. / TOPOLOGY_SET: RING, COMPLETE, DIRECTED_CYCLE, STAR (hub = node 0), RANDOM_GRAPH. / Undirected Erdos-Renyi G(N, p).
ambiguities.WHY_UNDERSPECIFIED: Only RANDOM_GRAPH is explicitly "undirected". For RING, COMPLETE and STAR the text does not state whether links are bidirectional (so out-neighbours = all graph neighbours).
POSSIBLE_INTERPRETATIONS: RING, COMPLETE, STAR are undirected graphs; out-neighbours of i are all its graph neighbours (i-1, i+1 for RING; all others for COMPLETE; hub for STAR leaves and all leaves for the hub).
RING/COMPLETE/STAR are treated as directed in a specific unstated orientation.
ambiguities.AFFECTED_CELLS_OR_METRICS: all RING, COMPLETE, STAR cells (63 of 105)
ambiguities.DECLARED_CHOICE: Interpretation 1: undirected; DIRECTED_CYCLE is the only directed topology (its name and the RANDOM_GRAPH "undirected" contrast imply the others are standard undirected graphs).

ambiguities.EXACT_PROTOCOL_TEXT: if destination total >= CAPACITY -> REJECTED, else move one E unit -> ACCEPTED.
ambiguities.WHY_UNDERSPECIFIED: "total" is not defined; it could mean all units (E + M) at the destination node, or only some subset.
POSSIBLE_INTERPRETATIONS: total = E_dest + M_dest (all units resident at the node).
total counts only units of a particular form.
ambiguities.DECLARED_CHOICE: Interpretation 1: total = E + M at the destination node; capacity is per node for all units (Section 1: "CAPACITY per node: 8 (uniform)").

ambiguities.EXACT_PROTOCOL_TEXT: A cell is INCONCLUSIVE regardless of its interval if, for any seed: valid steps < 0.90 x 1500, or post-burn rejections < 50, or mean Phi_emp over seeds = 0.
ambiguities.WHY_UNDERSPECIFIED: "mean Phi_emp over seeds = 0" does not state whether exactly zero or below some epsilon is meant.
POSSIBLE_INTERPRETATIONS: The guard triggers only when the mean is exactly 0.0 (as a floating-point value).
The guard triggers when the mean is below some unstated positive epsilon.
ambiguities.DECLARED_CHOICE: Interpretation 1: exact zero; no epsilon is invented (request forbids inventing thresholds).

ambiguities.EXACT_PROTOCOL_TEXT: Paired percentile bootstrap over the 16 seed-level pairs, B = 10000 resamples, random.Random(20261005). Each resample recomputes e as a ratio of means.
ambiguities.WHY_UNDERSPECIFIED: The resampling mechanism (how indices are drawn) is not specified; different mechanisms consume the RNG stream differently even though all yield the same bootstrap distribution.
POSSIBLE_INTERPRETATIONS: Draw 16 indices uniformly with rng.randrange(16) per resample.
ambiguities.AFFECTED_CELLS_OR_METRICS: all cells; ci_low, ci_high (interval endpoints only, not the point estimate)
ambiguities.DECLARED_CHOICE: Interpretation 1: rng.randrange(16) per index, 16 indices per resample, sequential over B resamples.

ambiguities.EXACT_PROTOCOL_TEXT: For each entry: draw u; if u >= p_move, no attempt. Otherwise choose destination uniformly from out-neighbours.
ambiguities.WHY_UNDERSPECIFIED: The API for the uniform destination choice is not specified; randrange, choice or int(random()*k) consume the RNG stream differently.
ambiguities.DECLARED_CHOICE: Interpretation 1: rng.randrange(len(dests)); all three are exactly uniform.

ambiguities.EXACT_PROTOCOL_TEXT: R_hat = SUM_j p_j with p_j = p_move x (fraction of full out-neighbours of the source immediately before opportunity j).
ambiguities.WHY_UNDERSPECIFIED: It is not stated whether opportunity j includes roster entries whose draw u >= p_move (i.e., every roster entry) or only actual attempts.
POSSIBLE_INTERPRETATIONS: p_j is computed for every roster entry (every opportunity), including those that do not attempt.
p_j is computed only for entries that attempt (u < p_move).
ambiguities.DECLARED_CHOICE: Interpretation 1: every roster entry is an opportunity; only under this reading is E[R - R_hat] = 0 by construction (each entry contributes expected p_move x full-fraction rejections).

ambiguities.EXACT_PROTOCOL_TEXT: UNDEFINED_GUARD_EDGE: "a step is valid only if A_t > 0 and SUM E_i > 0" — the protocol does not state whether Phi_snapshot of an invalid step is excluded from BOTH means (it says "excluded from both means").
ambiguities.WHY_UNDERSPECIFIED: The exclusion of invalid steps is stated for the means, but the per-seed valid_steps counter's treatment of steps where SUM E_i == 0 but A_t > 0, and vice versa, must be inferred.
POSSIBLE_INTERPRETATIONS: A step counts as valid only if both A_t > 0 and SUM E_i > 0; invalid steps are excluded from both means and from valid_steps.
valid_steps counts all post-burn steps regardless of validity.
ambiguities.DECLARED_CHOICE: Interpretation 1: the guard requires both conditions, so valid_steps counts only steps satisfying both.
